test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

After he finished eating his lunch, the boy sitting next to me ______ intently at me.
solution: The correct answer is **"stared."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Stared" **is the most appropriate option as it means to look fixedly or intently at someone or something. ((आश्‍चर्य, विक्षोभ आदि के कारण) किसी को देर तक देखते रहना; घूरना, टकटकी लगा कर देखना) • **Example**: *Everybody stared at his hat.* • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *After he finished eating his lunch, the boy sitting next to me **stared**__ intently at me.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "turned,"** means to move or cause to move in a different direction. ((किसी वस्‍तु का उसके मध्य बिंदु के चारों ओर) घूमना या (को) घुमाना) • **Option 3, "shared,"** means to have something in common with someone else or to divide something among a group. (किसी वस्‍तु को दो या अधिक लोगों में बाँटना) • **Option 4, "came,"** means to move towards someone or something. ((कहीं या किसी के पास) आना) 18d:Tdf8, The correct answer is **"of the nostalgic moments of."**
